title: Pressure Formula
text: The formula for pressure is $$P=\frac{F}{A}, $$ where $$F$$ is a force applied to an area $$A$$ that is perpendicular to the force. Here the force is the weight of $$1.00\, \text{g}, $$ $$F=mg, $$ and the area of the tip is $$A=\pi{}r**2.$$ Convert the mass to kilograms and the radius to meters.
